verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions full-text search for Appwrite's databases. The closest items are adjacent features: typed columns with generic indexes (TablesDB), vector similarity search over embeddings (VectorsDB), and a dedicated PostgreSQL database with pgvector. None of these is documented full-text search, so the axis applies but has no evidence of delivery.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run full-text search over my data without wiring up an external search service
